title: Desk cable grommet
prompt: Desk cable grommet for a 60 mm hole: a tube 60 mm outside diameter with a 2 mm wall, 20 mm long, and a 70 mm diameter, 3 mm thick flange at the top.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Exactly one solid body (one printable part)
70 mm flange, 23 mm tall overall, ±0.1 mm
Three cylindrical faces: tube inside, tube outside and flange rim
Three flat faces: tube end, flange underside and top
